name: Codon
oneLine: Three letters in a row that stand for one amino acid.
howItWorks: Four letters in groups of three give 64 combinations. Most name one of the twenty amino acids. Three mean stop.
deeper: The genetic code is nearly the same in every living thing. Why this code, and how it arose, is still an open question.
sizeComparison: a 100,000th the width of a hair
simplification: We highlight codons with gaps between them. Real mRNA has no gaps.
